# Mediabunny 1.65.2

Unmodified `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` from the official npm package, vendored as `mediabunny-1.65.2.mjs`.

- Source and release: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.65.2
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mediabunny/v/1.65.2
- License: Mozilla Public License 2.0, included in `MEDIABUNNY-LICENSE.txt`.

Loaded on recording completion to remux MP4 metadata or locally transcode a WebM recording into AVC/AAC MP4. No media is sent to a service.
